summary: Frontend-only regression test of the ATTENDY UI redesign on https://attendy-core.preview.emergentagent.com. Covered: login (all 3 roles + demo prefill + invalid-credential error), admin/TL dashboard (attendance ring + legend, team card w/ avatar group, payroll gradient card, Today's Attendance table, Tasks ring, Recent Activity), staff dashboard (dark 'Your Workday' hero, live timer, My Tasks, Leave ring, Latest Task), staff attendance (Check Out -> completion state, Workday Timeline, Today/Week/Month history filters), admin attendance (status count cards, date/department/status filters, mark-status dropdown w/ revert), Tasks Kanban (card chips/avatars/checklist bars/comment counts, keyboard drag&drop between columns with persistence after reload, detail dialog checklist toggle + add comment + status, Create Task for admin AND team_leader), Staff page (card grid + today's status badges, right-side profile drawer, 'View full profile' -> /staff/:id, search, Add Staff save), Employee profile (gradient header, salary edit persisted + reverted, all 4 tabs), Payroll (gradient total card, stat cards, table, status dropdown Draft->Approved->Draft, Generate), Staff Payslip (sidebar list, premium document preview, PDF download verified: payslip-EMP1003-2026-07.pdf), Leave (staff apply + admin reject), Settings tabs, sidebar collapse/expand, notification bell + mark all read, role route guard (TL /settings -> redirect), logout, and mobile 390x844 (bottom nav Home|Attendance|Tasks|Payroll|Profile, no horizontal scroll on Dashboard/Attendance/Tasks/Payslip). Zero JS console/page errors across all flows. All flows passed; only display/design issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: Times are rendered with new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN') without timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata', so timestamps are shown in the BROWSER timezone. In this (UTC) environment every check-in shows as 03:5x am while the shift is displayed as 09:30 AM - 6:30 PM (raw shift string, not TZ-converted). Result: Workday hero/timeline/attendance tables/payslip show inconsistent, apparently wrong IST times. Fix: pass { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' } in timeStr/dateStr/shortDate.

After check-out the timeline renders Check In -> Shift End (6:30 PM) -> Check Out (08:49 am), i.e. events are not in chronological order when an employee checks out before shift end. Order Shift End/Check Out based on actual times.
On completion the ring is forced to 100% (value=ringMax) even when only 4h55m of a 9h shift was worked - misleading 'Complete' visual. Consider showing actual worked/shift ratio.
Console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users' - the staff drawer has no SheetTitle (a11y).

issues: Secondary labels use text-slate-400 (#94a3b8) on white/#F6F8FA -> ~2.6:1 contrast, fails WCAG AA for small text. Affects stat-card labels ('Present/Late/Absent/Leave', 'Total employees', 'days remaining', 'PAYSLIPS', 'Salary Type'), all table headers (text-slate-400 text-xs) and timestamps. Use slate-500/600 for these.

design_issues.screen: Attendance (admin), Leave dialog, Settings > Attendance, Payroll
issues: Native browser pickers used instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover: <Input type='date'> (att-date, leave-from, leave-to), <Input type='month'> (payroll-month) and <Input type='time'> (shift start/end). Inconsistent with the redesigned look and OS-dependent.
Collapse toggle button had no data-testid (added 'sidebar-toggle' during testing).

action_items: Add timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata' to timeStr/dateStr/shortDate in /app/frontend/src/lib/format.js so IST times render correctly regardless of browser TZ.
Sort Workday Timeline events chronologically (Check Out before Shift End when checkout < shift end).
Raise contrast of text-slate-400 secondary labels/table headers to slate-500/600.
Add a SheetTitle (or VisuallyHidden title) to the staff profile drawer to remove the Radix a11y console warning.
Optional: replace native date/month/time inputs with shadcn Calendar/time components for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Attendance.jsx uses dynamic Tailwind classes text-${c}-600 for the status count cards; they currently resolve only because those literals exist elsewhere in the codebase. Safelist them or use a static map to avoid silent purge breakage.
Dashboard.jsx AdminHome legend shows 'Present' as present-late, so the label meaning differs from the backend stats.present field - verify intent.
No DELETE endpoint exists for employees, so staff created via Add Staff cannot be removed from the UI (test data had to be cleaned via Mongo).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of functional flows passed; 4 display/a11y issues + 3 design issues reported

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend redesign verified end-to-end; no functional regressions. Kanban drag&drop must be tested via keyboard (focus card -> Space -> ArrowRight/Left -> Space) since react-beautiful-dnd ignores synthetic mouse drags. Sidebar toggle now has data-testid='sidebar-toggle'. Staff drawer opens as [role='dialog'] from [data-testid^='staff-row-']. Remaining open items are display-only: UTC vs IST time formatting, timeline ordering, slate-400 contrast, native date pickers, Sheet a11y title. Backend untouched since iteration_1.
rca_of_the_issue: Time display anomaly (check-ins showing 03:5x am) is NOT a backend bug: timestamps are stored/returned correctly, but the frontend formats them with toLocaleTimeString using the browser's timezone (UTC in the test container) while shift times are printed from raw 'HH:MM' strings. Forcing timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata' in the format helpers makes all displays consistently IST.
